declare

begin
 --if :new_inter_blk.inter_code is null then -- Commented by Kishore on 04/29/2015. IM 14
 --show_error('18037'); /* Interdiction code cannot be null */ -- Commented by Kishore on 04/29/2015. IM 14

 if c_access = TRUE then
 :new_inter_blk.inter_desc := c_desc;
 :new_inter_blk.inter_type := c_type;
 else
 show_error('18033'); /*Access Denied for this code */
 end if; 

 end if; /* inter_code null if caluse */
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

-- This code was written by Edwin on 03/24/99 to take care of the coll date 

DECLARE
 v_c_date DATE;
 v_units NUMBER:=0;
 v_extension VARCHAR2(5);
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);


BEGIN

 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:=null; --- This variable is referenced by the library
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:=null;
 :new_inter_blk.coll_date:=null;

 IF :new_inter_blk.unit_id is not null then 

 If length (:new_inter_blk.unit_id)= 15 then
 szUnitId:=substr(:new_inter_blk.unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 Elsif length (:new_inter_blk.unit_id)= 7 then
 szUnitId:=:new_inter_blk.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='C';

 if ltrim(:new_inter_blk.unit_id,'0987654321') is not null then 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='A';
 else
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='N';
 end if;
 Else
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT(:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar,:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme,:new_inter_blk.unit_id);

 select nvl(count(unit_id),0) into v_units from donations where unit_id=szUnitId and
 donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;

 If v_units=0 then
 show_error('16215');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif v_units=1 then
 select coll_date into v_c_date from donations where unit_id=szUnitId and donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;

 :new_inter_blk.coll_date:=v_c_date; 
 set_item_property('new_inter_blk.coll_date',navigable,property_false);
 Else
 null;
 set_item_property('new_inter_blk.coll_date',navigable,property_true);
 End if;

 ELSE
 item_change('new_inter_blk.coll_date','D');
 END IF;

EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;

DECLARE
 v_local_dt date;
BEGIN

 IF :new_inter_blk.eff_date is null then
 show_error('11012'); /* Effective date cannot be null ,format should be MM-DD-YY*/
 ELSE
 -- IM 5202 starts
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_dt);
 else
 v_local_dt := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 -- IM 5202 ends
 If trunc(:new_inter_blk.eff_date) > trunc(v_local_dt) then /*IM 5202 sysdate > v_local_dt*/
 show_error('8030'); /* Future date not allowed : -- PR # 001.022121 */ 
 End if;
 
 If :new_inter_blk.term_date is not null then
 if :new_inter_blk.eff_date > :new_inter_blk.term_date then
 show_error('1316');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_dates;
 end if;
 End if;

 END IF;
 
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 --Change made by Kishore on 09/09/08 to display Donor information
 c_usps_id donor_addresses.usps_id%type;
 c_dob donors.date_of_birth%type;
 c_ssn varchar2(10);
 c_abo varchar2(5);
 chk_all number :=0;
 term_count number :=0;
 l_intl_addr_flag varchar2(1);
 -- End of change

 cnt number :=0;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_time1 date;
 v_local_date date;
 v_local_date1 date;
 v_str varchar2(2000);
 v_str1 varchar2(2000);
begin
 -- Change 1 made by Kishore on 09/09/08 to display Donor information
 if :global.action='CANCEL' then
 exit_form(NO_VALIDATE);
 end if;

 if is_timezone_enabled then 
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 
 else
 v_local_date := trunc(sysdate);
 
 end if;

 :ctrl_blk.donor_id := :find_donors.donor_id;

 /* populate name,date of birth , ssn ,sex*/

 select initcap(ltrim(rtrim(last_name)))||', '||initcap(ltrim(rtrim(first_name)))||' '||
 initcap(ltrim(rtrim(middle_name))),
 date_of_birth,
 decode(gender,'F','Female','M','Male'),
 nvl(blood_type,'NONE')
 into :ctrl_blk.name,
 c_dob,
 :ctrl_blk.sex,
 c_abo
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;

 
 :ctrl_blk.date_of_birth := to_char(c_dob,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 
 --=========================================================================
 select nvl(intl_Addr_flag, 'N') into l_intl_addr_flag
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and rownum = 1;
 
 if l_intl_addr_flag = 'N' then
 

 /* populate street , suite/apartment */
 begin
 select street_name,
 suite_apt,
 usps_id
 into :ctrl_blk.street_name,
 :ctrl_blk.suite_apt,
 c_usps_id 
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11212'); /* No address available */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /* populate city,state,zip */

 begin
 
 if nvl(c_usps_id,0) <> 0 then -- jairam added per IM 5295. on 20-apr-2011
 
 
 select zip,
 city,
 state
 into :ctrl_blk.zip,
 :ctrl_blk.city,
 :ctrl_blk.state
 from valid_city_state
 where usps_id = c_usps_id;
 
 end if;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18032'); /* City address is not maintained */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 
 else
 
 -- jairam intl addr here 
 
 SELECT A.INTL_aDDRESS_1||decode(A.INTL_ADDRESS_2,null,null,', '||A.INTL_ADDRESS_2)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_3,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_3)||decode(A.INTL_aDDRESS_4,null,null,', '||A.INTL_aDDRESS_4)||decode(A.COUNTRY_NAME,null,null,', '||A.COUNTRY_NAME)||decode(A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,null,null,', '||A.INTL_POSTAL_CODE ) 
 into :ctrl_blk.intl_Addr
 FROM donor_ADDRESSES A 
 WHERE donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and rownum = 1;
 
 
 end if;
 
 
 
 --=======================================================================================

 /* populate blood type */
 begin
 select substr(description,1,20)
 into :ctrl_blk.blood_type
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='ABO'
 and code=c_abo;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11040'); /* Invalid Blood Type */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 
 /* get other interdictions */
 begin
 select 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all=1 then
 :ctrl_blk.other_inter := 0 ;
 else
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl_blk.other_inter
 from donor_interdictions 
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)) 
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1); 

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 /* poplate existing interdictions and go to new_inter_blk to 
 enable the user to enter new interdictions */

 select count(*)
 into term_count
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1))
 and v_local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_local_date+1)) 
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and trunc(v_local_date)>trunc(term_date);
 
 if term_count>0 then
 item_change('ctrl_blk.show_term','E');
 end if;

 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 :system.message_level :='20';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level :='10';
 go_block('new_inter_blk');
 -- End of change 1



 select count(*)
 into cnt
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id=:ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and trunc(term_date )<trunc(v_local_date);

 if cnt=0 then
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk.show_term',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 descr varchar2(50);
 cursor c1 is
 select inter_code,
 inter_type,
 unit_id,
 eff_date,
 term_date,
 insert_user,
 release_user,
 originated_from,
 reason_code,
 group_mode,
 group_id
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) 
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and trunc(term_date)<trunc(sysdate)
 order by eff_date desc;
 

begin

 /* set insert allowed * delete allowed properties true to enable to
 insert the data */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 go_block('term_inter_blk');

 /* populate the block with terminated interdicions */

 for z in c1
 loop
 select inter_desc
 into descr
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=z.inter_code; 
 
 :term_inter_blk.inter_code := z.inter_code;
 :term_inter_blk.descrip := descr;
 :term_inter_blk.inter_type:=z.inter_type;
 :term_inter_blk.unit_id := z.unit_id;
 :term_inter_blk.eff_date := to_char(z.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.term_date := to_char(z.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.insert_user := z.insert_user ;
 :term_inter_blk.release_user := z.release_user ;
 :term_inter_blk.originated_from := z.originated_from ;
 :term_inter_blk.reason_code := z.reason_code ;
 :term_inter_blk.group_mode := z.group_mode ;
 :term_inter_blk.group_id := z.group_id ;
 next_record;
 end loop;

 /* delete the blank record created at the end of the block */

 delete_record;
 first_record; 

 /* set the insert allowed and delete allowed properties to false */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

end;

End if;

Exception when others then

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_old (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM ( p_exec_name);
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_dates IS
 multiFactor NUMBER:=0;
 v_min_date DATE;
 v_period_type VARCHAR2(1);
 v_min_period NUMBER:=0; 

BEGIN

 -- The following was added for PR # 001.022121

 select decode(substr(:new_inter_blk.period_type,1,1), 'D',1,
 'Y',365,
 'W',7,
 'M',30,
 'P', -1, -1) into multiFactor from dual;
 If multiFactor = -1 then -- -1 for permanent or null period type
 Null;
 Else
 v_min_date:=:new_inter_blk.eff_date + (:new_inter_blk.minimum_period * nvl(multiFactor,0)); 

 If :new_inter_blk.term_date < :new_inter_blk.eff_date then
 show_error('8052');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :new_inter_blk.term_date < v_min_date then
 :new_inter_blk.term_date:=null;
 show_error('21026',to_char(v_min_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));
 check_package_failure;
 else
 null;
 end if;

 End if;

Exception
 when value_error then
 null;
 WHEN others then
 handle_error;
End;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 c_status varchar2(250):= 'OK';
 p_transaction_id donations.transaction_id%type;
 szUnitId VARCHAr2(15);
 szChapter Varchar(5);

begin

 go_block('new_inter_blk');
 first_record;
 Loop

 --- This added by Edwin on 05-14-2001 to check ISBT or Codabar 

 IF Length(:new_inter_blk.unit_id)=15 then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:new_inter_blk.unit_id,1,13);
 
 Else
 szUnitId:=:new_inter_blk.unit_id;
 
 End if;


 if :new_inter_blk.inter_code is not null then
 begin
 
 if :new_inter_blk.unit_id is not null then
 select transaction_id
 into p_transaction_id
 from donations
 where unit_id=szUnitId and coll_date=:new_inter_blk.coll_date;
 
 else
 
 p_transaction_id := NULL;
 
 end if;
 
 If IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapter:='ALL';
 Else
 szChapter:=:global.chapter_id;
 End If;
 
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_place(:ctrl_blk.donor_id,
 szChapter,--:global.chapter_id,
 szUnitId,
 p_transaction_id,
 :new_inter_blk.inter_code,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.user_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :new_inter_blk.eff_date,
 :new_inter_blk.term_date,
 :new_inter_blk.notes,
 c_status);
 
 if c_status !='OK' then
 message('Inter Upgrade routine could not place the interdiction'||
 :new_inter_blk.inter_code ||' ERROR:'||c_status);pause;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 
 end if;
 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 :system.message_level :=25; /* to avoid the message 8013 */ 
 commit_form;
 show_error('9163');
 :system.message_level := 10;
 exit;
 end if;
 
 end;
 else
 
 show_error('18037');
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 

end;
